$schema_note: Copy to config/app-colours.json (gitignored) and add an entry per logo file in public/apps_logo/. Keys are logo keys: the file name lower-cased with everything but letters and digits removed ('Google Play Store.png' -> googleplaystore). A device-folder logo is keyed 'folderkey/logokey' and falls back to the bare key. A value is either a hex string or { hex, note } when the choice needs explaining. Run `npx tsx scripts/measure-logo-colours.ts` for proposals, then check each against the rendered logo.

chrome.note: The yellow arc: a paint in the file and what a person sees. The blue centre is the middle of the mark, not the mark.

x.note: Monochrome brand: a light neutral means 'this brand has no colour', and black would vanish on the page.

mylaptop/camera.note: Scoped: this device's Camera has its own artwork.
